title: Fatal aircraft mishap and four lost hours

tellings.quote: stands out as a story was that uh we had an aircraft mishap where um one of our pilots died.

plain: Greg Rogers, a doctor who served with a military unit called the Third Attack Battalion, says that while the unit was out in the field one of its pilots died in an aircraft accident. He tells it as something he went through himself, and links it to four hours that went missing and could not be accounted for.
